channel.title: FXStreet Forex & Commodities News
channel.description: Real-time Forex News and the latest trading updates. Stay updated on the latest news about currencies and commodities markets.

item.title: Turkish Lira: Rising inflation expectations pressure TRY – Commerzbank
item.description: Tatha Ghose at Commerzbank highlights that Turkey’s market-based inflation expectations for 2026 and 12 months ahead have risen again, undermining confidence in disinflation.

item.title: British Pound extends losses nearing 1.3400 as markets await Burnham’s policies
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is one of the weakest performers among major currencies, extending its reversal against the US Dollar for the fourth consecutive week.

item.title: Oil: Geopolitical premium persists as Gulf conflict escalates – BNY
item.description: BNY’s Geoff Yu notes that the U.S.–Iran confrontation and Houthi threats in the Red Sea are sustaining a geopolitical premium in Brent and WTI. Brent has risen toward $88 per barrel, with risks that Strait of Hormuz disruptions further tighten Oil supply.

item.title: 163.00: Why the Japanese Yen is close to year-to-date lows again
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) continues to trade on the defensive against the US Dollar (USD), lingering near year-to-date highs just below the 163.00 handle.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Tariffs and soft CPI pressure Loonie – BBH
item.description: Brown Brothers Harriman’s (BBH) Elias Haddad notes the Canadian Dollar (CAD) is underperforming other high-beta currencies after the Trump administration announced a 50% tariff on nearly $20 billion of Canadian imports, excluding energy and some key goods.

item.title: British Pound loses momentum as fiscal and monetary headwinds mount
item.description: The British Pound (GBP) is facing a notable loss of upward momentum across major currency pairs as UK political headlines and fiscal concerns re-emerge.

item.title: Hungarian Forint: NBH easing path and FX pressure – ING
item.description: ING’s Frantisek Taborsky expects the National Bank of Hungary (NBH) to cut rates by 25bp to 5.75%, continuing its easing cycle despite recent FX and rates pressure.

item.title: Australian Dollar hits fresh monthly highs above 0.7020 as risk aversion ebbs
item.description: The Australian Dollar (AUD) is showing one of the best performances among major currencies on Tuesday, appreciating to fresh one-month highs against the US Dollar, amid hopes of a ceasefire in Iran.

item.title: Indian Rupee gains ground as oil prices correct, Trump's decision awaited
item.description: The Indian Rupee (INR) opens higher against the US Dollar on Tuesday. The USD/INR pair corrects to near 96.34 from its two-month high of 96.76 posted on Monday, as fresh hopes of de-escalation in military aggression between the United States (US) and Iran have offered support to the Indian currency.

item.title: Gold Price Forecast: XAU/USD attempts Descending Triangle breakout near $4,070
item.description: Gold price (XAU/USD) is up 1.5% to near $4,067 during the European trading session on Tuesday. The precious metal outperforms as the rally in oil prices has stalled, with investors turning confident that negotiations between the United States (US) and Iran towards peace have resumed.

item.title: 162.70: Japanese Yen nears 40-year lows against the US Dollar
item.description: The Japanese Yen (JPY) keeps drifting lower on Tuesday, unfazed by the mild US Dollar’s weakness.

item.title: British Pound: CPI focus supports Sterling against US Dollar – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale strategists note that dip buying in Sterling has kept GBP/USD trading above its 200-day moving average near 1.3403, even as Gilts remain under pressure.

item.title: Japanese Yen: Energy shock and Japan policy risks – MUFG
item.description: MUFG’s Lee Hardman notes USD/JPY is holding just below year-to-date highs as a negative energy price shock weighs on the Japanese Yen. Rising Brent prices linked to US–Iran tensions and Houthi threats to shipping highlight global supply risks.

item.title: Hungarian Forint: MNB easing on lower inflation – Commerzbank
item.description: Commerzbank’s Tatha Ghose expects the central bank of Hungary Magyar Nemzeti Bank (MNB) to cut its base rate by 25bp to 5.75%, continuing June’s easing cycle.

item.title: Euro edges up to 1.1420 as Eurozone Economic Sentiment beats expectations
item.description: The Euro (EUR) edges up against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday, returning to levels just above 1.1420 after a three-day reversal from last week's highs at 1.1480 found support at 1.1400.

item.title: Silver price today: Silver rises, according to FXStreet data
item.description: Silver prices (XAG/USD) rose on Tuesday, according to FXStreet data. Silver trades at $58.96 per troy ounce, up 4.54% from the $56.40 it cost on Monday.

item.title: Czech Koruna: CNB stance supports CZK against Euro – ING
item.description: EMEA (Europe, the Middle East, and Africa) strategist Frantisek Taborsky at ING says regional data in Poland and the Czech Republic are constructive, but Central and Eastern European (CEE) FX remains driven by US–Iran tensions and Oil prices.

item.title: Oil: Escalation risks and Dollar support – OCBC
item.description: OCBC’s Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong highlight rising geopolitical risks around Middle East supply routes, warning that a deeper conflict could push Oil back above USD100/bbl and revive volatility.

item.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Tests nine-day EMA support near 1.3400
item.description: GBP/USD remains weaker for the fourth consecutive day, trading around 1.3430 during the European hours on Tuesday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates a prevailing bullish bias as the pair remains within the ascending channel.

item.title: Germany ZEW Survey - Economic Sentiment improves more than expected to 26.3 in July
item.description: German ZEW Survey - Economic Sentiment arrives at 26.3 in July, beating the estimates of 18.0 and the June reading of 10.5.

item.title: British Pound: Sterling trades in a broad range against US Dollar – UOB
item.description: United Overseas Bank’s (UOB) Quek Ser Leang judges GBP/USD price action as range-bound after an unexpected intraday spike and sharp drop. The pair is now expected to hold between 1.3400 and 1.3460 in the short term, with a broader 1.3385–1.3495 range for the coming weeks.

item.title: WTI Price Forecast: Struggles below $82.00 and one-month high; bullish potential intact
item.description: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – struggles to capitalize on the previous day's late rebound from the $79.50-$79.45 area and trades with a negative bias through the first half of the European session on Tuesday.

item.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD reaches $59.00 amid hopes of new US-Iran negotiations
item.description: Silver (XAG/USD) is rallying, favoured by a mild US Dollar weakness on Tuesday.

item.title: Copper: China tightness underpins prices – ING
item.description: ING Commodities Strategists Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey report Copper prices are supported by tightening physical conditions in China. Yangshan import premiums have surged on scrap shortages and smelter maintenance outages, while Chinese and LME inventories are low.

item.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Remains sticky to 20-day EMA
item.description: The US Dollar (USD) trades marginally lower against its major currency peers in Tuesday’s European session, as the appeal of safe-haven assets has diminished due to hopes of a ceasefire between the United States (US) and Iran.

item.title: Canadian Dollar: Trade dispute weighs on outlook – Commerzbank
item.description: Volkmar Baur at Commerzbank notes that new United States (US) tariffs of 50% on selected Canadian dairy, alcohol and automobile products under Section 338 will remove United States-Mexico-Canada Agreement (USMCA) exemptions.

item.title: Dow Jones futures rise as diplomatic signals ease Middle East tensions
item.description: Dow Jones futures gain 0.29% to trade around 52,220 during European trading hours on Tuesday. Meanwhile, S&P 500 futures and Nasdaq 100 futures advance 0.44% and 1.12%, trading near 7,520 and 29,100, respectively.

item.title: Gold stands firm near one-week high on softer USD; remains below $4,100 amid Fed hike bets
item.description: Gold (XAU/USD) hits a one-week high during the first half of the European session on Tuesday, albeit it lacks follow-through buying and remains below the $4,100 mark.

item.title: Indian Rupee: Intervention and inflows counter Brent shock – Societe Generale
item.description: Societe Generale’s Asian FX strategists, including Santosh Ejanthkar and Tanmay Purohit, report that the Indian Rupee (INR) is threatening to retest its record low near 96.9550/USD after Brent crude rose above $90.

item.title: Canadian Dollar recovers from one-week low vs soft USD; lacks bullish conviction
item.description: The USD/CAD pair retreats around 25-30 pips from a one-week high set earlier this Tuesday, and hits a fresh daily low during the first half of the European session.
